title: Músicas Alteradas
description: A texture that changes some musics from music discs.
body:
![Custom Music Discs Pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78939695059970e7ccc44a4937801800f47a993e.png)

A fun resource pack that replaces several vanilla Minecraft music discs with iconic real-world songs from different genres.
All songs were recreated in a Minecraft-inspired Note Block style (made with Minecraft Note Block Studio), giving each track a unique retro and pixelated sound that blends naturally with the vanilla experience.
Included Tracks


Eminem ft. Dido — Stan (13)

The Weeknd — Starboy (ward)

Forró Boys — Acabou (11)

Sabrina Carpenter — Espresso (lava_chicken)

Madonna — Hung Up (tears)

Mc Marcinho - Glamourosa (far)

Falamansa - Xote dos Milagres (chirp)

Ricky Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (pigstep)


Perfect for multiplayer servers, casual gameplay, and anyone who wants a more modern and chaotic jukebox experience inside Minecraft.
Features

This texture also introduce a redesigned custom jukebox texture for a fresher musical atmosphere in-game:

![3d_jukebox](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7412b0c8c6590a43a0c4c6ffb4d5294f1931620b_0.webp)

Enjoy your new music discs and custom jukebox in-game 🎵
